title: fuzz: fix bit-rotted fuzz_schc.c to current SCHC API (standalone build broken)
description: Child of b7z9.50. lichen/tests/fuzz/fuzz_schc.c fails to compile: references struct schc_reassembler_config and SCHC_FRAGMENT_ACK_ON_ERROR which no longer exist in lichen/subsys/schc (API refactored since the harness was written; clang errors at :130-137: forward declaration of 'struct schc_reassembler_config', undeclared SCHC_FRAGMENT_ACK_ON_ERROR). The other two harnesses (fuzz_frame, fuzz_schnorr48) build clean with clang 20 + ASan/UBSan standalone mode. Fix: update fuzz_schc.c to the current schc.h API (reassembler config struct/mode enums as they exist today), keeping the FUZZ_STANDALONE entry-point contract; verify with cmake lichen/tests/fuzz -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang && cmake --build (all 3 binaries) and a short standalone run of each binary over a small input (FUZZ_STANDALONE mains read stdin/argv? check harness main). Must not weaken coverage: the harness must still feed attacker-controlled bytes into the SCHC compressor/reassembler. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.50.
close_reason: Re-close (second resurrection): the fix is on origin/main — commit 6470607894 merged; verify: git show origin/main:lichen/tests/fuzz/fuzz_schc.c | grep -c schc_reassembler_config -> 0 (stale API gone), current fuzz_schc.c uses schc_reassembler_init per schc.h:264. Worker-4 released after my comment on this bead. Original close record (round 9) has full verification + 3x review evidence.
